# telnyx_access_ip_addresses (Data Source)

Lists access ip addresses, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_access_ip_address`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_at` (String)
- `filter_ip_address` (String) Filter by IP address
- `filter_ip_source` (String) Filter by IP source
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `access_ip_addresses` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_ip_addresses))

### Nested Schema for `access_ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)

- `status` (String) An enumeration.
